description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Dual Awoken Samurai Mode I (Lasswell)] to the user, grants [Samurai Resonance +3% Boost] to all Samurai allies

description.name: Dual Awoken Samurai Mode I (Lasswell)
description.text: Samurai abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Samurai abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for equipped Samurai abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Dual Awoken Samurai Mode II (Lasswell)] and [Instant ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Samurai Mode II (Lasswell)
description.text: Samurai abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Samurai abilities, and chases a Samurai Abilitiy with Dual Power of Secret Sword

description.name: Dual Power of the Secret Sword
description.text: Causes [Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)] and grants [ATK and MND +30%, DEF and RES +25% (8s)] to all allies

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 20% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 20% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 20% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 20% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 20% (15s)], [Imperil Water 20% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 20% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 20% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 20% (15s)]

description.name: ATK and MND +30%, DEF and RES +25% (8s)
description.text: ATK and MND +30%, DEF and RES +25%

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3
